socket_path.description: Path to the Unix-domain socket. Must be writable by the user running detachtty.

command.description: Absolute path to the command to execute. detachtty does NOT search PATH.

command_args.description: Arguments passed to the command. Must be a flat list of strings.

no_detach.description: If true, do NOT fork into background (useful for service managers or inittab).

log_file.description: File to write status messages (connects, disconnects, errors). Omit for stderr.

pid_file.description: File to write the PID of detachtty. Required to support SIGHUP log-reopen.

dribble_file.description: File to record all I/O to/from the child process (session logging).

socket_dir_mode.description: Octal permissions for the directory containing the socket (NOT a detachtty option, but strongly recommended).
